tei:div.tei:p: #!"# ༄༅// bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa las/ padma rgyal po'i sgos sgrub khol phyung bzhugs so//

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: 'gro ba dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir: gu ru sgrub pa'i thabs la gsum: sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: sbyor ba la gsum skyabs 'gro dang: sems bskyed gsol ba gdab pa 'o: skyabs 'gro sgo gsum yid dad pas: na mo: bde gshegs thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la: bdag sogs sems can skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed 'gro ba gzhan don du: bla ma'i rnal 'byor brtson bya bsam: gsol 'debs spyi gtsug bla ma bsgom: kye kye gu ru chen po la: sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rdzogs: bdag gi bsam pa bsgrub tu gsol: dngos gzhi la gsum bskyed rim dang: sngags bzlas rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o: bskyed pa dang po stong gsal las: hrīḥdamar 'od 'bar snang srid khyab: slar 'dus hrīḥnyid hūm̐ du gyur: hūm̐ las 'od 'bar pad sdong ni: rkang bzhi'i steng du dar 'bol brtsegs: de steng hūm̐ dmar gu rur bskyed: zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyil krung bzhugs: sku mdog dmar gsal zhi ma khro: dar dmar ber phyam sku la gsol: phyag g.yas lcags sgrog ḍā ma ru: phyag g.yon me long yig 'bru 'dzin:1$0000230 (a nṛ su tri pre du e sha truṃ dkyil du hūm̐/) 1$0000300thugs kar pad steng hūm̐ dmar las: 'od 'phros skye 'gro yongs la phog: gang la dmigs pa lcags kyus drangs: thugs kar dbang du 'dus par bsam: oṃ badzra gu ru padma rā dza a nṛ e pā shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐: bdun 'bum bzlas pas skye 'gro sdud: me long de bzhin rang yang bcang: rdzogs rim snang srid dmar 'byams 'od: tshur 'dus bdag nyid hūm̐ la rdzogs: hūm̐ nyid klad kor thig ler rdzogs: stong nyid snying rje'i ngang la gnas: dbang gi dngos grub nges par 'thob: rjes la gsum ste smon lam dang: rgyun spyod bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu 'o: smon lam 'di ltar bskyar zhing gdab:

na mo bla ma bsgrubs la sogs: dus gsum bdag gis tshogs bsags mthus: phrin las gang brtsam myur 'grub cing: bdag sogs bla med 'bras thob shog: rgyun spyod bla ma'i nga rgyal gyis: gzhan don dmigs pa'i gsag sbyang bya: 'bras bu bla ma'i sa non cing: gang ltar bsam pa'i dngos grub thob: padma rgyal po'i gsang sgrub 'di: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: : rgya rgya rgya: 1$0000230 zhes chos dbang rin po che'i zab gter gyi gtso bo bla ma gsang 'dus las sgos sgrub gung bsgrigs te khol du phyung ba'o/// /
